units.text: INT. FUNICULAR TICKET BOOTH - MORNING
A glass booth no bigger than a closet, perched at the bottom of a steep hill railway.
Brass fittings, a gentle hum of cable overhead.
ELOISE VANTERPOOL (30s, soft-spoken, wearing a belted coat) stamps tickets one by one.
Across the counter, DESMOND "DEZ" OKAFOR (30s, rumpled tweed, a paper bag of pastries) hovers.
Eloise, you have stamped that same ticket three times.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: Then it's very well stamped, Dez.
units.name: ELOISE

units.text: He slides the bag through the slot.
She peeks inside and smiles.
Apricot. Your favorite.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: You remembered.
units.name: ELOISE

units.text: I remember everything about you. Except where I left my umbrella.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: The booth door opens.
PRUDENCE LAWSON (60s, silver bun, carrying a knitted bag) steps in, shaking the damp from her shoulders.
Two for the summit, please. And don't let me interrupt.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: You aren't, Mrs. Lawson.
units.name: ELOISE

units.text: You aren't, Mrs. Lawson.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: Dear me. You two even speak alike.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: A tall man, THADDEUS BRIGHT (40s, conductor's cap), raps on the glass from outside.
Car's leaving, Prudence! Mind the step!
units.name: THADDEUS

units.text: Prudence waves, tucks her tickets away, and exits.
Eloise and Dez watch the car rise.
